title: Phool Bane Angaray
desc: Ranjit Singh uncovers strong evidence against a corrupt politician, putting himself at risk, while his wife courageously joins the police force to help him fight for justice.

title: Kyon Ki.Its Fate
desc: Anand loses his fiancee in a tragic accident and ends up in a psychiatric hospital. His doctor, Tanvi, falls for him-but her father stands against their love due to Anand's past.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Sanam
desc: Gaurav wants his father's love. After his brother dies, he joins the army to honour him and finally hopes to earn his father's respect.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Khiladi
desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney prank Sheetal's father with a fake kidnapping, but chaos ensues when Sheetal goes missing, putting them under suspicion and testing their innocence.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman, a martial arts teacher, gains superpowers during a fight with Raka. But Raka becomes stronger after toxic exposure, and Aman must defeat him to save others.
